name: Gauss-Seidel with Successive Over-Relaxation (SOR)
aliases: Gauss-Seidel with Successive Over-Relaxation (SOR) for 3D Heat Conduction
definition: An iterative numerical method to solve the steady-state heat equation (Laplace equation ∇²T = 0) in a 3D cubic domain. It updates grid points using the latest available neighbor values (Gauss-Seidel) and accelerates convergence by over-relaxing the update step (SOR).
summary: Gauss-Seidel SOR is an iterative method that solves the steady-state heat equation on a 3D grid by updating points with neighbor values and accelerating convergence via a relaxation parameter, implicitly solving for scalar fields rather than computing explicit gradients.
